29060-the-einstein-see-saw.title: The Einstein See Saw
29060-the-einstein-see-saw.creator: Unknown
29060-the-einstein-see-saw.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. With a hand that seemed limp with discouragement, he reached into his pocket for his cigarette-case. As he drew it out, the lackadaisical fingers failed to hold it firmly enough, and it clattered to the floor behind his chair. With the weary slowness of despondence, he dragged himself to his feet and went behind his chair to pick up the cigarette-case.

69478-the-girls-of-rivercliff-school-or-.creator: Unknown

It’s cruelty to animals to make me run in this awful sun,” and Mary Devine finally reached Elizabeth Baldwin’s side, and clung to her school friend’s arm, panting.

arxiv-2107-06193.title: Large-eddy simulations of marine boundary-layer clouds associated with cold air outbreaks during the ACTIVATE campaign– part 1: Case setup and sensitivities to large-scale forcings 2 2 footnotemark: 2
arxiv-2107-06193.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by . Large-eddy simulation (LES) is able to capture key boundary-layer (BL) turbulence and cloud processes. Yet, large-scale forcing and surface turbulent fluxes of sensible and latent heat are often poorly prescribed for LES simulations. We derive these quantities from measurements and reanalysis obtained for two cold air outbreak (CAO) events during Phase I of the Aerosol Cloud meTeorology Interactions oVer the western ATlantic Experiment (ACTIVATE) in February-March 2020.

arxiv-2108-04817.title: Impact of Dietary Habits and Opinionated Lifestyle during COVID-19 Pandemic : A Case Study on Engineering Students
arxiv-2108-04817.creator: Arpitha A. Deshpande ( arpitaadeshpande07@gmail.com ), Aadrika A. ( aadrika1916@gmail.com ), Rajeshwari K. ( rajeshwarik.ise@bmsce.ac.in ), Preetha S. ( preetha.ise@bmsce.ac.in )
arxiv-2108-04817.description: Abstract COVID-19 pandemic has introduced a new lifestyle due to lockdown. The impact was on food habits, working hours, and sleeping patterns. The goal of this study is to detect lifestyle changes caused by confinement during the COVID-19 pandemic, such as dietary habits, physical activities, and to explore changes in the body weight.

arxiv-2110-00331.title: One-loop same helicity YM amplitudes from BG currents
arxiv-2110-00331.creator: Pratik Chattopadhyay, Kirill Krasnov
arxiv-2110-00331.description: Abstract We propose and prove a new formula for the one-loop all same helicity Yang-Mills amplitudes. These amplitudes are seen to arise as a sum of products of two tree-level Berends-Giele currents connected by an effective propagator. To make sense of the propagators one needs to introduce the so-called region, or dual momenta.

arxiv-2203-16726.title: Hybrid normal mode and energy flux model for an ideal oceanic wedge environment with radial sound speed front
arxiv-2203-16726.creator: Mark Langhirt, Charles Holland, Sheri Martinelli, Ying-Tsong Lin, Dan Brown
arxiv-2203-16726.description: Abstract Energy flux is an acoustic propagation model that calculates the locally-averaged intensity without computing explicit eigenvalues or tracing rays. The energy flux method has so far only been used for two-dimensional problems that have collapsed the third dimension by rotational or translational symmetry.

arxiv-2205-15710.title: Coverage Probability of STAR-RIS assisted Massive MIMO systems with Correlation and Phase Errors
arxiv-2205-15710.creator: Anastasios Papazafeiropoulos, Zaid Abdullah, Pandelis Kourtessis, Steven Kisseleff, Ioannis Krikidis
arxiv-2205-15710.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate a simultaneous transmitting and reflecting reconfigurable intelligent surface (STAR-RIS) assisting a massive multiple-input multiple-output (mMIMO) system. In particular, we derive a closed-form expression for the coverage probability of a STAR-RIS assisted mMIMO system while accounting for correlated fading and phase-shift errors.

arxiv-2207-08934.title: Raman Photogalvanic Effect: photocurrent at inelastic light scattering
arxiv-2207-08934.creator: L. E. Golub and M. M. Glazov
arxiv-2207-08934.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by L. E. Golub and M. M. Glazov. We show theoretically that electromagnetic waves propagating in the transparency region of a non-centrosymmetric medium can induce a dc electric current. The origin of the effect is the Raman scattering of light by free carriers in the system. Due to the photon scattering, electrons undergo real quantum transitions resulting in the formation of their anisotropic momentum distribution and in shifts of electronic wavepackets giving rise to a steady state photocurrent.

arxiv-2211-14130.title: PUFFIN: PITCH-SYNCHRONOUS NEURAL WAVEFORM GENERATION FOR FULLBAND SPEECH ON MODEST DEVICES
arxiv-2211-14130.creator: Oliver Watts, Lovisa Wihlborg, Cassia Valentini-Botinhao † \dagger
arxiv-2211-14130.description: Abstract We present a neural vocoder designed with low-powered Alternative and Augmentative Communication devices in mind. By combining elements of successful modern vocoders with established ideas from an older generation of technology, our system is able to produce high quality synthetic speech at 48kHz on devices where neural vocoders are otherwise prohibitively complex.

arxiv-2303-03343.title: Mortality Rates of US Counties: Are they Reliable and Predictable?
arxiv-2303-03343.creator: Robert L. Obenchain, S. Stanley Young
arxiv-2303-03343.description: Abstract We examine US County-level observational data on Lung Cancer mortality rates in 2012 and overall Circulatory Respiratory mortality rates in 2016 as well as their “Top Ten” potential causes from Federal or State sources. We find that these two mortality rates for 2,812 2,812 US Counties have remarkably little in common.

arxiv-2311-02648.description: Abstract In recent years, the cellular industry has witnessed a major evolution in communication technologies. It is evident that the Next Generation of cellular networks(NGN) will play a pivotal role in the acceptance of emerging IoT applications supporting high data rates, better Quality of Service(QoS), and reduced latency.

arxiv-2405-16850.title: UniCompress: Enhancing Multi-Data Medical Image Compression with Knowledge Distillation
arxiv-2405-16850.creator: Runzhao Yang, Yinda Chen, Zhihong Zhang, Xiaoyu Liu, Zongren Li, Kunlun He, Zhiwei Xiong, Jinli Suo, Qionghai Dai
arxiv-2405-16850.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Runzhao Yang, Yinda Chen, Zhihong Zhang, Xiaoyu Liu, Zongren Li, Kunlun He, Zhiwei Xiong, Jinli Suo, Qionghai Dai. In the field of medical image compression, Implicit Neural Representation (INR) networks have shown remarkable versatility due to their flexible compression ratios, yet they are constrained by a one-to-one fitting approach that results in lengthy encoding times. Our novel method, “ UniCompress ”, innovatively extends the compression capabilities of INR by being the first to compress multiple medical data blocks using a single INR network.

arxiv-2502-10663.title: REAL: Realism Evaluation of Text-to-Image Generation Models for Effective Data Augmentation
arxiv-2502-10663.creator: Ran Li, Xiaomeng Jin, Heng Ji, Columbia University, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign rl3424@columbia.edu, {xjin17, hengji}@illinois.edu
arxiv-2502-10663.description: Abstract Recent advancements in text-to-image (T2I) generation models have transformed the field. However, challenges remain in generating images that reflect demanding textual descriptions, especially for fine-grained details and unusual relationships. Existing evaluation metrics focus on text-image alignment but overlook the realism of the generated image, which can be crucial for downstream applications like data augmentation in machine learning.

arxiv-2504-10009.title: The Bispectrum of Intrinsic Alignments: Theory Modelling and Forecasts for Stage IV Galaxy Surveys
arxiv-2504-10009.creator: Thomas Bakx †,1, Alexander Eggemeier 2, Toshiki Kurita 3,4, Nora Elisa Chisari 1,5, Zvonimir Vlah 6,7,8
arxiv-2504-10009.description: Abstract We present a complete treatment of the bispectrum of intrinsic alignments, both in three spatial dimensions and in projection in the flat-sky approximation. Since intrinsic alignment is a spin-2 observable, the bispectrum of intrinsic alignments contains a parity-even and a parity-odd part, the latter being nonzero even in the absence of parity violation.

arxiv-2602-15498.title: Scaling solutions in three-form cosmology
arxiv-2602-15498.creator: Vitor da Fonseca, Bruno J. Barros, Tiago Barreiro, Nelson J. Nunes
arxiv-2602-15498.description: Abstract A hybrid three-form model of dark energy is developed in order to identify scaling solutions, a long-sought feature in three-form cosmology. Exploiting Hodge dualities, the theory is formulated in terms of two scalar functions that are associated with the conjugate momentum, and the three-form dual vector in an isotropic background.

pmc-11479109.title: Urchin-like WO3 Particles Form Honeycomb-like Structured PLA/WO3 Nanocomposites with Enhanced Crystallinity, Thermal Stability, Rheological, and UV-Blocking and Antifungal Activity
pmc-11479109.creator: Sihem Daikhi, Salim Hammani, Soumia Guerziz, Huda Alsaeedi, Syreina Sayegh, Mikhael Bechlany, Ahmed Barhoum
pmc-11479109.description: The development of poly(lactic acid) (PLA) nanocomposites incorporating urchin-like WO3 particles through a cost-effective solution-casting method has led to significant enhancements in structural, thermal, optical, and rheological properties. The incorporation of these WO3 particles up to 7 wt% resulted in the formation of an irregular honeycomb-like morphology with broad pore sizes ranging from 14.1 to 24.

pmc-11504124.title: Diagnosing Pneumonia in the Obese: Are Plain Radiographs Enough?
pmc-11504124.creator: Alwyn Rapose
pmc-11504124.description: Introduction: The obesity pandemic presents numerous challenges in radiography, including patients exceeding the weight limits of imaging equipment, difficulties in palpating anatomical landmarks and inadequate penetration resulting in inaccurate diagnoses and need for repeat imaging resulting in increased radiation exposure.

pmc-11641045.title: Comprehensive Analysis of Bioactive Compounds, Functional Properties, and Applications of Broccoli By-Products
pmc-11641045.creator: Iris Gudiño, Rocío Casquete, Alberto Martín, Yuanfeng Wu, María José Benito, Annalisa Tassoni
pmc-11641045.description: Broccoli by-products, traditionally considered inedible, possess a comprehensive nutritional and functional profile. These by-products are abundant in glucosinolates, particularly glucoraphanin, and sulforaphane, an isothiocyanate renowned for its potent antioxidant and anticarcinogenic properties. Broccoli leaves are a significant source of phenolic compounds, including kaempferol and quercetin, as well as pigments, vitamins, and essential minerals.

pmc-11646439.title: Integrated Analysis of Single-Cell and Bulk RNA-Sequencing Based on EcoTyper Machine Learning Framework Identifies Cell-State-Specific M2 Macrophage Markers Associated with Gastric Cancer Prognosis
pmc-11646439.creator: A-Kao Zhu, Guang-Yao Li, Fang-Ci Chen, Jia-Qi Shan, Yu-Qiang Shan, Chen-Xi Lv, Zhi-Qiang Zhu, Yi-Ren He, Lu-Lu Zhai
pmc-11646439.description: BackgroundTumor is a complex and dynamic ecosystem formed by the interaction of numerous diverse cells types and the microenvironments they inhabit. Determining how cellular states change and develop distinct cellular communities in response to the tumor microenvironment is critical to understanding cancer progression.

pmc-11669964.title: Physical and psychological symptoms and survey importance in celiac disease
pmc-11669964.creator: Edward J Ciaccio, Anne R Lee, Jessica Lebovits, Randi L Wolf, Suzanne K Lewis
pmc-11669964.description: Celiac disease is an autoimmune condition that affects approximately 1% of the worldwide community. Originally thought to be confined mostly to the small intestine, resulting in villous atrophy and nutrient malabsorption, it has more recently been implicated in systemic manifestations as well, particularly when undiagnosed or left untreated.

pmc-11704535.title: Randomized study of temporary diaphragm pacing for enhanced recovery after surgery in cardiac surgery patients at risk of prolonged mechanical ventilation
pmc-11704535.creator: Jessica R. Hungate, Raymond P. Onders, Mohammad El Diasty, Yasir Abu-Omar, Rakesh C. Arora, Cristian Baeza, Yakov Elgudin, Kelsey Gray, Alan Markowitz, Marc Pelletier, Igo B. Ribeiro, Pablo Ruda Vega, Gregory D. Rushing, Joseph F. Sabik
pmc-11704535.description: ObjectiveProlonged mechanical ventilation after cardiac surgery significantly increases morbidity and mortality. The aim of this study is to establish the role of diaphragmatic pacing to decrease mechanical ventilation burden in high-risk patients undergoing cardiac surgery.MethodsThis is a prospective, randomized trial of temporary diaphragmatic pacing electrode use in patients undergoing cardiac surgery (NCT04899856).

pmc-12611348.title: Rare Record of Albinism in a New Zealand Fur Seal ( Arctocephalus forsteri ) Pup With Observations Through the Weaning Period
pmc-12611348.creator: Alasdair A Hall, Robyn A Grant, Jody Suzanne Weir
pmc-12611348.description: The rarity of heritable pigment anomalies in marine mammals makes it challenging to assess their fitness ramifications. Potential negative effects include reduced visual acuity, greater predation risk, increased disease vulnerability, lower fertility and decreased heat absorption. Logging instances of heritable pigment anomalies can improve understandings of their impacts and potentially permit their use in understanding metapopulation dynamics.

pmc-12686511.title: SIRT3–IDH2 axis is a target of dietary fructose: implication of IDH2 as a key player in dietary carcinogen toxicity in mice colon
pmc-12686511.creator: Jeong Hoon Pan, Nukhet Aykin-Burns, Kimberly J. Krager, Hyo Ri Shin, Chae Hwan Lee, Jin Hyup Lee, Byungwhi Kong, JaeEun Myoung, Kyung-Chul Choi, Jae Kyeom Kim
pmc-12686511.description: Recent epidemiological studies have shown that dietary fructose intake is associated with an increased risk of colorectal cancer, yet its specific molecular mechanisms in colon carcinogenesis remain underexplored. Here we investigate the molecular mechanisms by which dietary fructose contributes to colon carcinogenesis, focusing on the role of mitochondrial NADP+-dependent isocitrate dehydrogenase 2 (IDH2).

pmc-13248743.title: Intra-Abdominal Compartment Syndrome Secondary to Massive Pelvic Müllerian Tumor
pmc-13248743.creator: Sidra Shah, Tarunjog Singh Kalra, Durkho Atif, Umara Niazi
pmc-13248743.description: Abdominal compartment syndrome (ACS) is a rare surgical emergency characterized by end-organ dysfunction resulting from sustained elevation of intra-abdominal pressure. Gynecological malignancies are an uncommon cause of ACS. We report the case of a 61-year-old woman who presented following an unwitnessed fall with hypotension, tachycardia, confusion, and marked abdominal distension.

pmc-13300111.title: Comparative analysis of pulsed-field, cryoballoon, and radiofrequency ablation for atrial fibrillation across body mass index strata: a multicenter study
pmc-13300111.creator: C Gold, J Kupusovic, K Avranas, A Falagkari, J W Erath-Honold, I Arigoni, V Johnson, F Post, E Roth, K Schmidt, L Rottner, A Luik, D M Leistner, A Fuernkranz, R Wakili
pmc-13300111.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundSeveral studies have compared current atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation modalities and identified elevated Body-Mass-Index (BMI) as a predictor of arrhythmia recurrence, evidence on procedural and clinical outcomes across BMI subgroups pertaining to different techniques remains limited.MethodsThis retrospective multicenter analysis included consecutive patients undergoing first-time pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) with Pulsed-field ablation (PFA, Farapulse), Cryoballoon ablation (CBA), or high-power short-duration Radiofrequency ablation (RFA) in three electrophysiology centers from 2020 to 2024.

pmc-13339106.description: β-Ga2O3 exhibits great potential for next-generation power electronics, while its low thermal conductivity poses a challenge to efficient heat dissipation. We address this challenge by developing a gallium-assisted epitaxial strategy to synthesize highly oriented β-Ga2O3 film on diamond. The β-Ga2O3 presents a high thermal conductivity of 9.0 W m−1 K−1 and low thermal boundary resistance of 6.05 m2 K GW−1.
